name: Columbus Energy
summary: Columbus Energy S.A. engages in the provision of solutions in the field of photovoltaics and modern energy products for households and businesses in Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Ukraine. It also offers heat pumps, energy storage, electric car charging stations, as well as photovoltaic installations and alternative net-billing. The company was formerly known as Columbus Capital S.A. and changed its name to Columbus Energy S.A. in March 2016. Columbus Energy S.A. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.
